dct_description_sm: The dataset is a copy of the raw gel image files and values extracted from those gels for all the graphs and tables in the paper and supplementary file for "The Mycobacterium tuberculosis Ku C-terminus orchestrates LigD activity through domain-specific interactions" to be published in Nucleic Acids Research in 2026 from the lab of Dr. Sara Andres.
dct_title_s: The Mycobacterium tuberculosis Ku C-terminus orchestrates LigD activity through domain-specific interactions
